args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).
Bump to 2.9.4, the patched release in the 2.x series.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
**Why:** `requirements.txt` pinned `fastjson==2.8.0`, which is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

**What:** Bumped fastjson to `2.9.4`, the patched release in the 2.x series (per the advisory, affected versions are `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed in `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`). This is the minimal safe upgrade with no other dependency changes.

**Testing:** CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `c8b8ab787`.

cc @alex for review.
